description: Starts a project kept here under a projectId: a blank board, or one of the example projects (perfboard://examples/...) to copy from. Returns the projectId and the project file. Then add parts and wires with edit_project, and pass the projectId to every other tool instead of the whole file.

example.description: Start from an example instead of a blank board: "555-led-blinker" (555 LED blinker (perfboard)), "555-led-blinker-stripboard" (555 LED blinker (stripboard)).

name.description: The project's name, used by make_share_link.

strips.description: A stripboard's strips: along rows (horizontal, default) or columns.

type.description: perfboard (default): a separate pad per hole. stripboard: copper strips joining every hole along each row (or column).

name: new_project
title: New project
